storageCompatibility.oldReplayPlayback: Native keyframe interpolation on engine-version mismatch or detected kernel/keyframe drift; both releases use p7, so old recordings need not immediately enter interpolation and deterministic re-simulation is not promised.

performanceOptimizations.framerate: Ported numeric browser cap, RAF timestamp, deadline tolerance; settings UI is integrated separately.
performanceOptimizations.hud: Ported shared display-clock queue and unchanged render-option gate. Native status widgets retained; old field-specific gates are not applied to new ability schemas.
performanceOptimizations.botOrder: Ported same-frame publish/subscribe and rendered actor offset for labels and aim lines; existing badge CSS patch is required.
performanceOptimizations.world: Ported stable light Top-K and inactive screen canvas hiding. Optional spatial regrouping/fence polling remains disabled.
performanceOptimizations.renderAllocation: Reuse renderer-local actor-ID scratch storage and write actor/camera scalar interpolation directly; retain snapshot, simulation, RNG and replay semantics.
performanceOptimizations.instances: Ported separate instance visibility compaction transform and active-viewport map resource leases.
performanceOptimizations.muzzleLayer: Ported visibility based on emitted geometry, preserving mask/order.
performanceOptimizations.muzzleUpload: Ported prefix update ranges and empty generator exit.
performanceOptimizations.impactTracer: Ported bounded impact Mesh/Material pool and retained warm entries; native shared atlas retained. Native new tracers already batch bounded geometry and upload active prefixes; old tracer visuals intentionally not restored.
performanceOptimizations.interpolation: Ported adjacent simulation snapshots for actors and camera XZ; native vertical stair smoothing and new held-weapon/ability state preserved.
performanceOptimizations.prewarm: Await tracked scene preparation, stable skin selection/audio and current model readiness before simulation starts. Native shader/map shadow warmup retained; first-wave actors retained and temporary skeletons released. Old loading UI/coordinator is not transplanted into new ability lifecycles.
performanceOptimizations.actorPrewarm: Ported reservation/commit/dispose pool without advancing simulation or RNG.
performanceOptimizations.trainingHall: Existing trainingHallVisibilityCss remains compatible; append in build.
